reason: Both help local home-service businesses win customers, so customers and the lead-generation goal overlap. But Thryv sells SaaS and done-for-you marketing services to small businesses. Angi runs a two-sided homeowner marketplace and earns fees and advertising revenue from pros. Angi's homeowner side and marketplace model have no Thryv counterpart, and Thryv's CRM/SaaS has no Angi counterpart. The overlap is partial on both product and customers, so this is adjacent rather than direct.
